clips.title: The story
paras: Standing Our Ground is a decisive quest where an adventurer stands alongside Aamelia Windfield in a desperate confrontation against a menacing bandit leader. Having prepared the defenders for battle, you face what seemed like a lost cause to secure safety from the brigands.

Standing Our Ground marks the climax of a desperate struggle against a gang of bandits. Having helped prepare the local defenders for an inevitable clash, you are given one final opportunity to walk away and return safely to Valanaar rather than throw yourself into what appears to be a doomed last stand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.
This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.
On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I... Can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.
